Revenue by region

Detail

RegionRevenueOrdersShare
Why the West grew: the detail table shows the West's order count rose faster than its average order, so the gain came from more buyers rather than larger baskets.

Query

SELECT r.name AS region,
       SUM(o.total) AS revenue,
       COUNT(*)     AS orders
  FROM sales.orders o
  JOIN sales.regions r ON r.id = o.region_id
 WHERE o.placed_at >= DATE '2026-07-01'
 GROUP BY r.name
 ORDER BY revenue DESC
